img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality (ECE, 15-bin, lower is better) and intra-domain false-reject rate. Hatched bars with italic n/a: CICC was only evaluated on CLINC150. On the single-intent benchmark CICC/MULACONF are poorly calibrated (ECE 0.16) and reject 59-64% of in-domain queries to maintain coverage; on multi-intent MULACONF ECE worsens to 0.54 on MixSNIPS and false-rejection reaches 0.82-1.00. QP-10shot over-generates and never rejects (false-reject 0.00) but its confidence is miscalibrated (ECE 0.15-0.47). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false refusal within 4.6-20.8%.
